verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own DGX B200 docs give memory capacity only at the system level: 8 x B200 GPUs with 1,440 GB total, which implies 180 GB per GPU. The 14.4 TB/s figure is NVLink interconnect bandwidth, not memory bandwidth, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: memory type (e.g., HBM generation), memory bus width, per-GPU memory bandwidth, and a per-part B200 spec sheet rather than system-level totals.
